mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Party_B_Id as conPartyBId, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, met.Met_Name as metName, c1.C_Name as wiUnitName, c2.C_Name as conPartyBName, c1.C_Abbreviation as wiUnitAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, ea.Ea_Code as eaCode, mn.* from Me_Inspection_Report mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Me_Witness_Inspection wi on wi.Wi_Id=mn.Wi_Id left join Me_Enter_Apply_Dtl ead on ead.Ead_Id=wi.Ead_Id left join Me_Enter_Apply ea on ead.Ea_Id=ea.Ea_Id left join Me_Type_Library met on met.Met_Id=ead.Met_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on wi.Wi_Unit_Id=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on con.Con_Party_B_Id=c2.C_Id where mn.Ir_Id=#{irId}
